$comment: X-27 AUTH-ASSURANCE REGISTRY (design-authority-owned, umbrella §13.4; the X-25 registry model: registering a method or adjusting an admissible set is a REGISTRY ACTION, not a code or version change). The table is an explicit admissible-TUPLE table, never a scalar ordering: the finding warns that required assurance depends on the full method/combination, so each registered method carries the LoA labels it can truthfully claim, and each evidence context the (identity, LoA) tuples admissible for it — with combined-factor ELEVATION stated where a wallet signature (a possession factor over signed content) admits a lower session LoA. PILOT-PROVISIONAL: these floors are the pilot profile's provisional set. TODO(legal): the adopted floors' relation to the applicable standards and legal framework — which combinations satisfy which Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 obligations per evidence context — awaits counsel review and is LEFT OPEN; until then the table binds the reference deployment only (TS clause 6). Enforced fail-closed by evidence_lint LINT-AUTH-03; an UNREGISTERED well-formed method is accepted, preserved verbatim and treated as unassessed (LINT-AUTH-W1, the safe-generic-processing convention).

mls-x509.note: Entity-credential channel authentication (QSealC-anchored MLS session); cannot on its own claim very-high.

wallet-eid-high.note: EUDI wallet eID authentication at LoA high or above.

password-otp.note: Knowledge + OTP possession; never claims high.

mls-uid-qeaa.note: UID QEAA carried as the MLS leaf credential (bw_uid_qeaa; OPTIONAL/experimental per X-19).

mls-x509+oidc4vp.note: X-08: mls-x509 plus a completed out-of-band OID4VP ceremony. Claimable ONLY with a channel-bound (channel_id-in-nonce) RETAINED transcript (umbrella §10.2); the ceremony adds policy enforcement, not LoA — the admissible set is the base method's.

mls-uid-qeaa+oidc4vp.note: X-08: as mls-x509+oidc4vp, over the QEAA leaf credential.

sender-signed.elevation: Combined-factor elevation: the sender wallet signature over the full D4 submission tuple is a possession factor the session LoA alone does not express, so a substantial session is admissible UNDER the signature. This row is WHY the reference SE (mls-x509/substantial) is admissible — only because origin_proof is sender-signed.

provider-attested.note: The narrowed mode leans wholly on the provider-attested session — a stronger session is required.

wallet-signed.elevation: The member's wallet signature over the confirmation content elevates the session.

session.note: A session-only confirmation of a legally operative delivery requires a high-or-above member session.

de-availability.note: The authenticated-S2 retrieval session (the Article 44(1)(c) anchor); no confirmation object exists at this grade.

wallet-signed.elevation: The refusal_confirmation wallet signature elevates the session.

gcm-dispute.note: The disputing member's reveal is itself a legally consequential act.
